label: Теперь
description: A 10-sentence usage card for теперь (now; nowadays — implying a change).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Now after a change. Fronted 'теперь' means now in the sense of a new state, contrasting with an earlier lack of understanding. It marks that something has changed since before.
Strategic focus: Now in a dilemma. In this question 'теперь' asks what to do given a newly arisen situation. It implies circumstances have shifted and a fresh decision is needed.
Strategic focus: A new era ahead. With a future verb 'теперь' announces that things will differ from now on. It explicitly draws a line between past and future.

missions.phrase: Раньше он курил, а теперь нет.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Then versus now. Paired with 'раньше' the adverb 'теперь' completes a before-and-after contrast. This frame is the classic way to express a habit that has stopped.
Strategic focus: Now it is your turn. 'Теперь' marks the present moment as the point at which the turn passes over. It works well to hand off an action to someone else.
Strategic focus: Now after a move. The question with 'теперь' asks about a current situation that has replaced an old one. It assumes the living place has recently changed.
Strategic focus: Now that things are settled. Fronted 'теперь' signals that a previous obstacle is gone and rest is finally possible. It conveys relief at a changed circumstance.
Strategic focus: Current state replacing an old one. 'Теперь' presents living in Moscow as the new arrangement. Unlike a neutral сейчас, it stresses the contrast with where one lived before.
Strategic focus: Now as a discourse pivot. Here 'а теперь' shifts attention to a new point in a conversation or speech. It functions almost like and now to introduce the next part.
Strategic focus: Now it is too late. 'Теперь' frames the present as the moment after which change is no longer possible. It looks back at a window that has closed.
